authority: User instruction of September 27, 2026 choosing the audited redraw (ledger Entry 46). The exact replay of the preseason packets is impossible: the preseason TeamInputs were built transiently and never committed, so no packet can reproduce the committed digests.
rule: Each missing projection is drawn once from runtime/injuries.py, the model every club's generated injuries use, conditioned only on the class and restriction recorded when the injury was generated. A head/neck injury is an independent medical hold at every severity, so it constrains nothing; an 'out' restriction means at least one day. Later availability records (from September 4 onward) are not used as evidence: they were written without the projection, which is the defect being corrected. The projected return is the injury date plus the drawn days, the rule injured_out applies to every club; on and after that date the player is available like any background player.
